notes.title: Release 0.4.0 is here!
notes.notes:
Hello!

The latest release for The Island of Eternal Struggle is here!


New Content
- Added the Sea Monster dungeon - a new area where Ian and the crew will face off against nasties from within the belly of a beast. Literally!
- Added Crystal Cove - a new area with strange creatures, chock full of destructable walls.
- Added Discotech Ruins - the ruins of Xenon's home, where a menace awaits the party...
- Added a new class for Ian - Harvester! This healer/spellcaster class uses energy from dead enemies and allies to aid and destroy.
- Seven new enemies
- Three new boss fights (with achievements)
- Added 33 new equipable items

Quality of Life Updates
- Updated level scaling throughout the game significantly
- Added new updated boss death animations for every boss leading up to the new content
- Added enhancements to the particle system in combat
- Added enhancements to the dialogue system


Bugfixes
- Fixed a bug during the church cutscene that would cause the screen to go black
- Fixed a bug where status ailments were not displaying correctly
- Fixed a graphical bug on the doors in Swampy Acres
- Fixed an item shop display issue


Thanks for your continued support!

The Wimbus Studios Team

notes.title: Release 0.3.7 is here - featuring the Crusader class!
notes.notes:
Hey everyone,

It's that time again! Release 0.3.7 is here, with a brand new job class for Faye - the Crusader.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29029828/b1204d35662315d31128f356d83d430a12119853.png

The Crusader class specializes in taking and dealing physical damage to enemies. When Faye is hit, she stores damage as a new state called Redemption. When using skills, she can use Redemption to deal extra damage and inflict additional effects on the enemies. However, if she overcharges her attacks without enough Redemption, it will backfire!

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29029828/68bb2425778101f55eb8efb7d938a92457a1fa95.png

Crusader is a great class for Faye as it counterbalances her other two fragile, magic-based classes. Leveling as a Crusader to earn passive skills that will make Faye stronger and more durable will help her throughout the game!

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29029828/9ddc9de8b8f54324944d2e95a837dcc21211f01d.png

Patch Notes:

Features:

 Added Crusader as a playable job class for Faye!
 Added 24 new unlockable Crusader skills.


Bugs:

 Fixed a bug that would cause Xenon to not be in your party after defeating the boss in the Raver Warehouse.


Thank you for your continued support!

The Wimbus Studios Team

notes.title: Release 0.3.4 - Release Notes
notes.notes:
Another patch approaches!

The team fixed a few bugs and made some balance tweaks to Ian's Squire class and Faye's Cleric class.

Bugfixes:

 Fixed some grammar mistakes in the first town.
 Fixed a bug that allowed Faye to earn dice as her Cleric class while she was dead in combat.
 Fixed a bug that caused Brutal Strike to miss if enemies had no marks.
 Fixed the physical positioning of several enemy parties in the desert area.


Balance:

 The Squire ability "Battle Shout" was entirely too powerful, and allowed Ian to spam Barrier and MP across the party at no cost if executed properly. Battle shout now no longer restores MP to party members, but successful action commands now refund the MP cost to Ian.
 The Squire ability "Improved Shout" now no longer gives an MP recovery bonus
 Faye's Cleric dice generation was too generous, and the cap of dice that can be accrued has been limited to 6 (down from 10). Don't worry, she can still kick butt.


Other stuff:

 Some behind the scenes stuff in prep for 0.4.0


More fun stuff coming soon! As always, thanks for your continued support!

The Wimbus Studios team

notes.title: Release 0.3.3 - Patch Notes
notes.notes:
Good evening!

This weekend we some time at the Too Many Games convention in Oaks, PA. Thanks to the feedback and playtime of the folks kind enough to visit our booth, we found a few bugs in our latest patch which we've fixed this evening. This should resolve a few class-related issues and some intermittent crashes.

Bug fixes:

 Fixed a crash that would occur when certain particle effects would play outside of combat.
 Fixed a bug where Bera's Booze Hound class would heal dead party members in combat


Balance/Damage fixes:

 Fixed an issue where damage was being calculated wrong for Bera's Hotshot class.
 Reduced the number of dice that Faye's Cleric class was generating without passive skills.



Thank you for your continued feedback! As always, don't hesitate to drop us a line on social media or in the Discussion Board! Making this game great is important to us, so your feedback is a gift.

The Wimbus Studios Team

notes.title: Release 0.1.15 Patch Notes
notes.notes:
Good evening!

A new patch is now available for The Island of Eternal Struggle with lots of balance changes around Action Commands and the Finesse stat. These changes are aimed at increasing the reward of performing Action Commands successfully during battle while shifting that damage boost to be based more on that characters core stats and Finesse.

Updates:

 The base damage of normal attacks have been decreased by about 20%. However, the damage potential has been overall increased by 10%. 
 Cleric - Using more dice in combat now has a greater damage/healing boost and has more influence from the Finesse and Magic stats
 Squire - The damage boost of successful Action Commands has been changed from a flat % damage boost, to being influenced by Attack /Magic and Finesse.
 Squire - The skill Hyper Focus now grants a small MP Boost to the entire party if executed successfully
 Templar - Increased overall damage/healing from successful Action Commands by about 5%-10% depending on the skill
 Discomancer - Increased the influence of Finesse for familiar stats by about 20%
 Booze Hound - Finesse now has a significant influence on the number of button presses while executing Action Commands to produce additional drinks.



Also included in this update, are some back end future feature updates and support for the following areas:


 Uncanny Valley
 Discotech


Until next time!
- Wimbus Studios

 Booze Hound - Finesse now has a significant influence on the number of button presses while executing Action Commands to produce additional drinks.



Also included in this update, are some back end future feature updates and support for the following areas:


 Uncanny Valley
 Discotech


Until next time!

notes.title: Release 0.1.9 Patch Notes
notes.notes:
Hello all,

The latest release, version 0.1.9, is now live!

New/enhanced stuff:
- Added lots (70+) additional sound effects to combat as well as better handling for effects on the back end
- Locked doors in the Catacombs now can be interacted with

Bug fixes:
- Fixed a bug where certain drops from Jazz Mummies would crash the game
- Fixed a game where certain attacks from Hungover Vampires would deal no damage
- Fixed some save point issues in Beak's Peak and the Ruins of the Ancients
- Fixed an issue where Heroic Strike would not select another target if the original target died
- Fixed an issue where Mighty Boon was not restoring MP properly
- Fixed some typos


Balance Changes:
- Reduced random encounter rate slightly in the Catacombs
- Increased overall healing and scaling of Hymn of Hope
- Decreased overall damage and scaling of Cherry Bomb
- Decreased overall healing and scaling of Bandages

We're looking forward to sharing what comes next in the coming days. Thank you for playing!

Wimbus Studios
